scoring_justification: Headline sputtering yields are the output of a full MD simulation pipeline; verifier cannot rerun, so result-level compare with tolerance and trend checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference yields for all 12 conditions (surface, energy, species) used for tolerance comparison.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from Fig. 4 of the paper (Harafuji & Kawamura, Jpn. J. Appl. Phys. 49, 08JE03, 2010). Values approximate the plotted data points.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Read from published figure and rounded to two decimal places; Ga yields on clean surface are exactly 0.0 per paper statement.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are direct quantitative results from the paper's main experiment and are required to verify reproduction.

outputs.description: Sputtering yields for Ga and N on clean and Cl-adsorbed wurtzite GaN(0001) surfaces for Ar ion impacts at 100, 150, and 250 eV. The checker compares yields to the paper-reported values with appropriate tolerances and verifies the trend that Ga yield is negligible on clean surfaces and significant and energy-dependent on Cl-adsorbed surfaces.

output_contract.notes: The checker uses hidden reference values extracted from Fig. 4 of the paper and performs structural trend checks.
